scope: Local routing, exact file identity, grouped source cards and reference integrity; not a new semantic-accuracy benchmark.
checks: Both application editions pass lint and whitespace checks.
Both browser scripts pass JavaScript syntax checks.
Frontend grouping preserves evidence objects and original citation positions.
A grouped [1, 4, 5] card opened the document matching its metadata in browser verification.
coverage: Complete greeting/help/thanks routes precede history, model readiness and MCP access.
Greetings followed by substantive document or inventory requests retain their normal route.
Uncited answers to document-based imperatives use the bounded retry and excerpt fallback.
Exact long titles, document IDs and paths distinguish files with equal basenames.
An individually unfit long path does not suppress later usable evidence.
Forced final synthesis repacks evidence without tool schemas before inference.

checks.request: is there a file named api.md?

live_measurement_limits: Each listed HTTP input was measured once on the Linux development laptop.
Greeting timings include local HTTP and message persistence but no model inference or retrieval.
Catalog timings include MCP metadata access, not language-model generation.
No private source text, private conversations or database is included in this record.

historical_results_unchanged.production_context_replay: 64/64 initial evidence delivery; RAG AFVM 7/24, agent AFVM 3/24
historical_results_unchanged.later_9b_probe: 8/8 known checks, 2/2 unknown abstentions; small postselected development probe

limitations: Citation checks establish format, numbering and delivered-evidence identity, not claim entailment.
The source-driven citation policy can also retry an uncited proposal in Chat if retrieval supplies documents.
Whole-document summaries and Projects planning have separate flows and are not newly evaluated here.
Native Windows 11 GPU inference remains unmeasured.
test_fixture_note: The two-source refresh test uses 12288 context tokens to reserve space for complete records and tool schemas across native Windows temporary-path lengths; all two-record and payload/card assertions remain intact. Other 4096/8192 stress fixtures and production defaults are unchanged.

native_windows_ci.platform: Native Windows Server GitHub Actions runners
native_windows_ci.scope: Native filesystem, API, actual MCP, persistence, packaging, PowerShell syntax and CMD launcher lifecycle with synthetic data and a fake local model service.
